_meta.role: Robotics Software Engineer – Perception & Edge AI

summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from RIT focused on real-time perception and Edge AI for robotics. I build and deploy computer vision and object-tracking software onto NVIDIA Jetson and embedded controllers, optimizing inference with TensorRT/CUDA and fusing multi-sensor input into robotic control loops in Python and C++.

experience.title: Research Intern (Capstone)
bullets: Architected a metal-surface inspection perception pipeline (image stitching, wavelet denoising, ZoeDepth monocular depth estimation) achieving ±8% error on 3D crack-depth reconstruction.

experience.title: Deep Learning Intern
bullets: Trained YOLOv8n on a custom 1,133-image object-detection dataset achieving 83% mAP@50; exported to ONNX and TFLite for on-device deployment.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Built a gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and Bluetooth to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands in Python, with custom z-axis tap detection and jitter calibration.

experience.title: General Secretary — Robotics
bullets: Led a 25-member robotics team across national competitions; fabricated custom PCBs in EAGLE and implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled, Vision-Guided Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Built a vision-guided robotic pick-and-place system across a distributed Jetson+Arduino edge stack (Flask-SocketIO server, WebSocket fabric); integrated TensorRT-optimized YOLO (5.2× speedup, 92 FPS) for visual servoing and dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping.
Resolved 11 integration failures (false detections, servo brown-out, stale-frame capture); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s voice-to-picked latency.

projects.name: Autonomous Driving Perception Stack in CARLA
bullets: Built automated CARLA data pipelines (semantic segmentation, raycast occlusion filtering) generating ~8,000 auto-labeled YOLO/UFLD frames; trained YOLO11n (mAP50~0.85) and fine-tuned UFLD (ResNet-18) into an adaptive lane-following control stack, validated at zero collisions in Town02.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret (Jetson + STM32)
bullets: Ran YOLOv8 object detection/tracking on NVIDIA Jetson driving an STM32 over UART; implemented interrupt-driven multi-servo PWM control with FreeRTOS mutexes and VL53L0X ToF range sensing.

projects.name: ROS-Based Robotic Arm (AL5B & UR5e)
bullets: Derived DH tables and forward kinematic chains for a 6-DoF UR5e and 5-DoF AL5B, validated against MoveIt/RViz URDF models in ROS 2 Humble/Noetic; executed collision-free pick-and-place on physical UR5e via the UR ROS 2 driver (AL5B repeatability <2mm).

awards: Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
